title: Lump-Sum Settlement Extensions on Accounts Whose Payment Arrangement Was Superseded
content:
# Lump-Sum Settlement — Superseded-Plan Allowance

A plan under Ridgeline's Payment Arrangements that was cancelled because a settlement superseded it bears on a due-date extension of the accepted Lump-Sum Settlement under its Settlement Agreements.

**Rule.** Where a payment plan on the settled account was cancelled because the settlement superseded it and that plan recorded no missed installment, the Lump-Sum superseded-plan allowance of 2 days is added; where such a superseded plan recorded at least one missed installment, the Lump-Sum superseded-plan allowance is 1 day; an account with no plan superseded by the settlement carries no Lump-Sum superseded-plan allowance.

A superseded plan is one whose closing reason on the plan record is superseded by settlement; its missed installments are those recorded in its installment history.

## Combinations

| Plan on the settled account closed as superseded by settlement | Missed installments recorded | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 2 days |
| yes | one or more | 1 day |
| no such plan (no plan, or a plan closed for another reason) | — | none |

## Hypothetical cases

1. A plan was cancelled the day the Lump-Sum Settlement was accepted, with the closing reason superseded by settlement, and every installment had been paid: 2 days.
2. The same, but the plan had recorded two missed installments: 1 day.
3. The account's only plan was completed long before any settlement: no allowance.
4. An earlier plan on the account, closed for another reason, recorded missed installments, while the plan cancelled as superseded by settlement recorded none: 2 days, because only the superseded plan's own installments are read.
